info.banner: For a new project, fill in the following. For an existing project, it is auto-prefilled by scanning and can be edited. Later options are recommended by the LLM based on this info.
info.legendNote: Describe intent first; no need to pick tech item by item
info.goalTip: Whose problem are you solving, in one sentence.
info.summaryTip: Main features, target users, expected form (Web/mobile/…).
info.budgetTip: e.g. no budget / under 100k / existing cloud resources.
info.backgroundTip: Team status, existing systems, timing, collaboration.
info.requirementTip: Hard constraints: mandatory languages/frameworks, compliance, performance, deployment.

mode.banner: The following mode is pre-selected by the LLM based on "Project Info" and can be adjusted.
mode.newBuildDesc: No existing code; from requirements to a runnable product.
mode.iterateDesc: Add features or change behavior on the existing architecture and style.
mode.refactorDesc: Improve structure / migrate stack / pay debt without changing external behavior.
mode.otherDesc: Custom mode with an optional note.
mode.otherPlaceholder: Describe the mode, e.g. data migration / design only
mode.defaultHint: One click: generate with all defaults (LLM recommendations + per-step defaults) — scenario + memory + project_spec.md — then close the wizard (skips Step3–5).

stack.bannerA: Step3 varies by mode. Current mode "Greenfield": choose the scaffold (stack & architecture), pre-filled by the LLM.
stack.bannerB: Step3 varies by mode. Current mode "Iterate": collect the existing codebase context (stack comes from scanning; no need to re-select).
stack.bannerC: Step3 varies by mode. Current mode "Refactor": define constraints (behavior-preservation strategy / verification / special roles).
stack.bannerOther: Step3 varies by mode. Current mode "Other": skip the template and go straight to the scenario editor (reuses the existing editor).

ptype.componentDesc: Reusable components such as workflow/decision engines.
ptype.gameTeam: Focus: frontend / UX / graphics (presets to be extended)

platform.note: Combinable; selecting Web / Mobile / Mini-program auto-checks "Frontend"

arch.note: Determines team layers and decomposition granularity
arch.threeTeam: Typical team: frontend, backend, data engineer
arch.microDesc: Multiple services + API gateway, split by boundary.
arch.microTeam: Typical team: frontend, backend, integration coordinator, data engineer
arch.serverlessDesc: Functions as a service + BaaS, ops-free.
arch.serverlessTeam: Typical team: frontend, backend (functions), DevOps engineer

b.accessLocalDesc: Point directly at the current workspace.

c.targetStructureDesc: Extract functions/classes, remove duplication, improve naming.
c.targetArchDesc: Split monolith into microservices, re-layer, decouple modules.
c.targetDebtDesc: Remove dead code, fix known defects.
c.techNote: Current comes from scanning; fill target when migrating
c.keepStrictDesc: All existing tests must pass; public API signatures unchanged.
c.keepCompatDesc: Internal tweaks allowed; external interfaces stay compatible.
c.keepBreakingDesc: Requires a clear migration path and versioning strategy.

stack.otherModeHint: Custom mode: skip the template and go straight to the scenario editor (reuses the existing editor) to configure scenario and agents manually; project_spec.md is written afterwards (mode=custom).

summary.banner: Review the scanned / selected results (editable); the last part is auxiliary options (project config presets), changeable later in Settings.

preview.willWrite: Will write: scenario dir · project memory · project_spec.md
preview.addMemberHint: Sub agent prompts are composed for this project; edit them here or add/remove members. On failure it falls back to agent references.
preview.name: Name
preview.composeFailed: Prompt composition failed; fell back to agent references
preview.refEditHint: Agent content is referenced; edit it in Extensions · Agents
preview.generateHint: Generation runs in the background; please keep this window open.

memory.contentHint: This is the initial seed content (pre-filled by the wizard) — written to memory/<category>.md as a starting point at generation; afterwards it accumulates automatically.
memory.promptHint: The rewrite instruction (system prompt) for this category, different from the "content" on the left; empty falls back to the built-in default prompt.

desc.greenfield: We are a {arch} R&D team focused on {platforms}; tech stack: {fe} + {be}. Project goal: {goal}
desc.refactor: Refactor the existing system ({stack}) (target: {target}, behavior preservation: {keep}): {goal}
